summary: The failures point to positional `*` width and precision arguments being resolved with the wrong indexing state or argument ID. The zero-index cases also report an indexing-mode error instead of the expected missing-argument error. The supplied excerpts do not show the parser and lookup logic needed to identify a concrete repair.
hypotheses: Positional width and precision parsing selects the wrong argument IDs, causing values to come from the wrong arguments or fail integer conversion.
A zero positional index after `*` is treated as an automatic argument reference before missing-argument validation, producing the wrong diagnostic.
The argument lookup path used for larger argument packs may differ from the path used for small packs and mishandle these positional references.
